name: brachydactyly type A7
description: Brachydactyly type A7 (Smorgasbord type) is a form of brachydactyly that presents with the characteristic features of brachydactyly type A2 (shortening of the middle phalanges of the index finger and, sometimes, of the little finger) and type D (shortening of the distal phalanx of the thumb) plus various additional features.
